sections.title: Scenario
sections.prompt: Who decides, what does the agent do for them, and which numbers shape the design?
criteria: States that analysts make every disposition and the agent drafts
Turns 6,000 alerts at 25 minutes into analyst hours and a capacity saving
Names the SAR 30-day clock and the 10-minute onboarding target as constraints
Treats the examiner as a user with a 7-year replay requirement

sections.title: Single View
sections.prompt: Draw the system across three entities and the legacy systems.
criteria: Deploys a full stack per jurisdiction rather than one stack with routing
Separates deterministic risk rules or scorecard from the drafting model
Includes a write-once record store for replay
Shows how cross-entity risk is shared without moving customer data

sections.title: Data Sources
sections.prompt: How does evidence reach the agent from Actimize, the mainframe, Temenos and vendors?
criteria: Reads the mainframe by change data capture or an equivalent that avoids new load on the core
Keeps each entity's data in its own region
Screens against live sanctions and PEP lists

sections.title: Processing
sections.prompt: How is a case's evidence assembled, and what does the model actually see?
criteria: Computes transaction aggregates in code or SQL rather than by the model
Stamps every evidence item with source, record id and fetch time
Shrinks the raw 80k-token evidence to a stated smaller pack
Sizes any self-hosted model in GPUs per region

sections.title: Agents
sections.prompt: What does the model do, how is it constrained, and what does it cost?
criteria: Lists cost levers in order with a monthly saving for each, using the given prices
Uses a fixed step plan rather than a free-form tool loop, for repeatability
Requires every factual sentence to cite an evidence id
Chooses the recommendation from a fixed list with reason codes

sections.title: Memory
sections.prompt: What is remembered, and what must never carry across customers?
criteria: Keeps memory per case with no cross-customer memory
Treats prior cases as cited evidence fetched by tool
Routes learning from analyst edits through a validated release

sections.title: MCP Tool Servers
sections.prompt: Which tools exist, and which deliberately do not?
criteria: Provides typed read-only evidence tools per region
Has no tool to close, escalate or file a SAR
Labels any written draft as AI-prepared in the case manager

sections.title: Endpoints
sections.prompt: How do analysts, onboarding and examiners interact with the system, and how fast is onboarding?
criteria: Lands drafts in the existing case manager rather than a new tool
Gives a stage latency budget for low-risk onboarding under 10 minutes
Approves low-risk onboarding on the validated scorecard without waiting on the model
Provides an in-region replay endpoint for examiners

sections.title: Caching
sections.prompt: What may be cached when stale evidence is a compliance error?
criteria: Never caches sanctions or PEP screening
Shows the fetch date of any cached evidence
Prompt-caches the stable procedure prefix

sections.title: Data Stores
sections.prompt: Where does each entity's data live, how much is there, and what does it cost?
criteria: Sizes the 7-year record store from cases a month and bytes per case
Uses immutable storage such as S3 Object Lock in compliance mode
Keeps workflow history and logs in region too
Gives a monthly total with non-model prices labeled as assumed

sections.title: Output
sections.prompt: What does the analyst receive, and what does the examiner receive?
criteria: Narrative sentences cite evidence ids
Stores the analyst's edits as a diff against the draft
Replay bundle includes model id and prompt and procedure version hashes

sections.title: Guardrails
sections.prompt: Which controls satisfy the regulators and protect customers?
criteria: Ensures adverse decisions have meaningful human review (GDPR Article 22 or equivalent)
Prevents tipping off by giving the agent no customer channel
Puts model changes through each entity's model risk process with pinned versions
Runs below-the-line testing on cases the agent rated low risk

sections.title: Key Impact
sections.prompt: How do you prove analysts are faster without missing suspicious activity?
criteria: Measures minutes per alert with a randomized holdout
Pairs speed with a detection measure such as below-the-line results or SAR conversion
Includes backlog age against the regulator's finding

sections.title: Failure Modes
sections.prompt: What breaks, and what does the bank do?
criteria: Never fails over across regions
Never skips screening during a vendor outage
Orders backlog by SAR deadline

sections.title: Build Order
sections.prompt: In what order do you build across three regulators in 12 months?
criteria: Ships deterministic evidence packs before the model
Schedules model validation before production in each entity
Rolls out one entity at a time with a number per phase
